items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] This is Jimmy Noon, is it? Yes, Jimmy Noon. [INTERVIEWEE] This is Jimmy Noon.

ctx.x: This is Jimmy Noon, is it? Yes, Jimmy Noon.
I have a better picture. I was out and saw Johnny St. Cyr about two years ago. Stayed at his house for over a month.
